name: What the Sky Has Left Behind
source:
None could recall how many seasons had turned since the Tita Legion razed the Priest Tower to ash. In Senbanrou—a realm within the Faya Alliance—yet another campaign was launched against the corrosion that had never truly been stopped, as had been done in the years before. But this time, the old patterns did not hold.

At the Sixth Academy of LuoLake, on a morning that bore no mark of what was to come, news arrived without warning: the Governor's Guard was approaching. And so, a movement unlike any that had come before began to unfold—slowly at first, until it could no longer be turned away from.
translation:
早已无人记得，自提塔军团将祭司之塔夷为灰烬以来究竟过去了多少个春秋。在法亚联盟辖境内的千番楼，人们一如往年那样，向从未真正止息的侵蚀再度发起了讨伐。然而这一次，往昔的惯例却不再奏效。

在洛湖第六学院，一个毫无异兆的寻常清晨，一则消息毫无预警地传抵院中：总督卫队正在逼近。就这样，一场前所未有的时代洪流悄然拉开帷幕——起初只是暗流轻涌，直至再也无人能够移开视线。
